text: Plain HOLA score beta||e|| FAILS here: needle_in_cache 0.12-0.31, ms+hola 0.716 < ms 0.983. Three causes: (a) first-filler-of-theme scores m~1 same as needles (constant erase_gate = no learned beta to separate them); (b) multi-state block resets inflate m for block-first tokens; (c) filler values are ~0.6% longer than unit needles (v_theme+noise not renormalized) so topk systematically prefers filler. Fix: consolidation-aware eviction (demote cache entries whose key the state later predicts well) + confidence-gated lambda from cache softmax top weight.
